question.text: Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs) are registered with:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.65, Commodity Trading Advisors are registered with the local regulator, the National Futures Association (NFA) in USA, and follow the Managed Futures strategy, deploying systematic or discretionary managed-futures positions in commodity, equity, and currency futures. The Trap: SEBI is India's securities regulator, the FCA is the UK regulator, and IOSCO is a global standard-setting body for securities regulators; none is the CTA registrar per p.65. Note: The NFA registration and the systematic/discretionary managed-futures description are taken directly from workbook p.65.
